cloud_provider.title: Cloud provider
cloud_provider.description: Cloud provider that stores the exports. Defaults to AWS when omitted.

auth_mode.title: Authentication method
auth_mode.description: How to authenticate with AWS. Defaults to Access Key and Secret

aws_access_key_id.title: AWS access key ID
aws_access_key_id.description: Access Key ID with read/write access to a bucket.

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: External ID for the IAM role

gcs_bucket_name.title: GCS bucket name
gcs_bucket_name.description: Google Cloud Storage bucket and optional folder containing the exports. Required for GCP.

gcs_service_account.title: Service account key
gcs_service_account.description: JSON service account key with permission to list and read objects in the bucket. Required for GCP.
